content:
Alien Metals Limited (AIM: UFO), a minerals exploration and development firm, has revealed that its joint venture partner West Coast Silver Limited (ASX:WCE) WCE (ASX:WCE) has obtained firm commitments to raise A$6 million (around a33.2 million) via a placement aimed at institutional, sophisticated, and professional investors. These funds will expedite exploration and development drilling at the Elizabeth Hill Silver Project in Western Australia, where Alien Metals holds a 30% stake. This announcement follows a recent drilling campaign that uncovered both near-surface and deeper mineralisation. The placement is anticipated to close on or about 8 September 2026. Investors in Alien Metals are closely monitoring this development due to the company's combined exposure through its joint venture interest and its 30.5 million shares in West Coast Silver.

Key Points

  • Alien Metals Limited (AIM: UFO) is a minerals exploration and development company listed on AIM
  • Joint venture partner West Coast Silver has raised A$6 million through a placement to accelerate exploration at Elizabeth Hill
  • The placement is priced at A$0.095 per share, reflecting a 13.8% discount to the 15-day VWAP before West Coast Silver's trading halt; completion expected around 8 September 2026
  • Upcoming exploration at Elizabeth Hill South and West, along with mineral resource estimate updates and a scoping study, are key milestones to watch

West Coast Silver Placement Offered at 13.8% Discount to Fund Elizabeth Hill South and West Exploration

West Coast Silver set the A$6 million placement price at A$0.095 per share, representing a 13.8% discount to the 15-day volume-weighted average price prior to the trading halt. The company reported demand significantly exceeded targets, attracting support from both new and existing investors. Admiralty Resource Fund, linked to Paul Cronin, invested A$500,000 acquiring 5,263,158 shares. The placement is expected to finalize on or near 8 September 2026, subject to standard conditions.

Elizabeth Hill Drilling Campaign Reveals Near-Surface and Deep Mineralisation at Historic High-Grade Silver Site

Elizabeth Hill is historically significant in Australian mining, having yielded some of the country's highest-grade silver ore in the late 1990s. Recent drilling identified both near-surface and deeper mineralisation in initial holes, underpinning the accelerated work program now funded by the placement. Proceeds will support exploration and development drilling, geotechnical and metallurgical testing, an updated mineral resource estimate, and a scoping study, all aimed at progressing the project toward a development decision.

Alien Metals Maintains 30% Free-Carried Interest and 8.7% Equity Stake in West Coast Silver Before Placement Completion

Alien Metals holds a 30% interest in the Elizabeth Hill joint venture, free-carried until West Coast Silver declares a Decision to Mine. Before the placement completion, Alien also owns 30.5 million West Coast Silver shares, equating to roughly an 8.7% stake in the company’s issued capital. This dual exposure provides Alien with direct project involvement and equity participation in West Coast Silver’s activities, meaning the A$6 million placement-funded exploration acceleration could impact Alien’s asset portfolio on multiple fronts.

Alien Metals' Extensive Australian Assets Include Georgina Basin IOCG Project and Munni Munni PGM Property

In addition to Elizabeth Hill, Alien Metals manages a broad portfolio of Australian exploration assets. Its wholly owned Georgina Basin IOCG Project covers about 2,500 km b2 of tenure in the East Tennant region of the Northern Territory, featuring seven granted exploration licences and over 90 conceptual IOCG targets. The company also holds a 30% interest in the Munni Munni platinum-group metals project in the Pilbara, where a historic estimate reported 2.2 million ounces of platinum-group metals and gold. Alien Metals further owns 37.9 million shares in joint venture partner GreenTech Metals Ltd.
